question: Mawlid is another name for which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milad-un-Nabi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Milad un-Nabi is a gazetted holiday in India and is also known as Nabi Day, Mawlid, Mohammad's Birthday, or the Prophet's Birthday.
 
• Milad-un-nabi festival is celebrated to mark the birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad.
 
 
• This day is celebrated in the month of Rabi’ al-awwal (Third month of the Islamic calendar).
 
• It is celebrated by Muslims all over the world.
 
• It was first celebrated as an official festival in Egypt.
 
• On this day the followers of Prophet Muhammad will discuss and celebrate the advent of the Prophet Muhammad's birth and his teachings.
 
 
 
• Prophet Muhammad was an Arab religious and political leader.​
 
 
• Muhammed was born in Mecca.
 
• He is considered the founder of Islam.
